title: The BASSO Venta - A perfect frameset to upgrade

takeaways.text: The Venta 105 listed at £2,899 in May 2023 and was on sale at about £2,470.

Geometry suits riders with limited hip mobility who still want race handling: steeper seat angle, slightly shorter reach and a steep head angle; he had some toe overlap on a size 56 with size-11 shoes and rearward cleats.
Not as stiff or lively out of the saddle as a high-modulus SuperSix or Dogma, but close when cornering; on rough roads it passes more chatter than a premium frame.
The stock wheels are heavy enough to disappoint on a test ride; swapping to roughly £1,000 Reynolds ARX41 wheels transformed acceleration and handling.
Teardown found faced bottom-bracket and brake mounts, clean internal routing with protectors, a frame protector fitted as standard, thick quality paint and correctly installed brake adapters.
The seatpost is proprietary with a crescent profile and rear-bolt clamp, which he rated one of the better proprietary designs; bars and stem are standard alloy.

disclosure: The shop bought the bike from the UK distributor for a customer and reviewed it before handover; the wheels came from a retailer unaware of the review.
summary: A UK workshop's ride and teardown of a 2023 old-generation BASSO Venta Disc 105 in size 56, with a stock-versus-upgraded-wheel comparison.
